class.name: GameInstance
class.brief_description: Application-lifetime object, created once at startup and never reloaded.
class.description: Outlives levels and game modes, so it is where state that must survive a level change belongs. Created from the [code]application/game_framework/game_instance_script[/code] project setting. Extend it in GDScript and override [code]_on_init[/code] and [code]_on_shutdown[/code]. If the setting is unset the framework warns and continues without a game instance.

method.name: _on_init
method.description: Override for application-lifetime setup: load the save, read settings, prepare state that has to survive a level change. Gameplay tags are already resolvable here - [World] builds [GameplayTagsManager] before it creates the instance.

method.name: _on_shutdown
method.description: Override to tear that down. Called once, as the world goes away.

method.name: create_local_player
method.description: Adds a human at this machine. See [enum PlayerInput.DeviceSlot] for [param device_slot]; pass [constant PlayerInput.DEVICE_SLOT_NONE] for a player that will pick up a device by pressing a button later. Local players are owned here rather than by the [GameModeBase], so they survive [method World.open_level].

method.name: create_local_player_with_slots
method.description: For a player who owns more than one device, such as keyboard and mouse plus a pad.

method.name: find_local_player_for_device_slot
method.description: The human holding [param device_slot], or null if nobody does. Press-to-join uses this to tell a new device from one already claimed.

method.name: get_local_player
method.description: The human at [param index] - 0 is player one. Returns null past the end.

method.name: get_local_player_count
method.description: How many humans are at this machine.

method.name: get_world
method.description: The world this instance belongs to.

method.name: remove_local_player
method.description: Frees the player. Remaining indices are kept dense, so player 1 becomes player 0 when player 0 leaves.

signal.name: local_player_added
signal.description: A human joined at this machine.
